paragraphs: I'm Fazal Hossen Pranto, a video editor and content creator based in Bangladesh. I make video that is clear, well paced, and built to hold attention.
I'm also a student of education, studying B.Ed in Educational Administration. That background shapes how I structure ideas, so the people watching actually understand and remember them.
I create Bangla educational content for YouTube and Instagram Reels, including the series "How We Learn?", which explains Educational Psychology for university students.
